summary: Loads Substance .sbsar materials, exposes generated material parameters, and outputs selected procedural texture maps.

key_params.name: reloadconfig
key_params.note: Reload the Substance file and generated parameter layout.

key_params.name: graph
key_params.note: Substance graph to use from the file.

key_params.name: invertnormal
key_params.note: Invert DirectX -Y normal maps when needed.

common_gotchas: Generated parameters and Output menu entries change with the loaded .sbsar and selected graph.
Use Invert Normal for DirectX-style -Y normal maps when the material expects OpenGL-style normals.
Grid Preview is an Output menu choice for inspecting maps.
CPU engine mode is legacy; GPU is the current/default engine path.
key_concepts: Substance TOP loads .sbsar files and exposes parameters generated by the selected Substance graph.
The Output menu selects a generated texture layer such as a map or grid preview.
Substance outputs can be dragged onto PBR Material workflows or separated with Substance Select TOP.
The engine can run legacy CPU mode or current GPU mode, with GPU implemented through Vulkan on Windows and Metal on macOS.
